shared_elements: carved stone slab/monument with rough outer edge
standing human figure occupying most of the field
elaborate headdress or headgear at the top
circular disc/medallion ornament on the chest area
rectangular blocky panels or cartouche-like elements arranged in vertical sequence
held staff-like or elongated object beside the body
justification: Both are tall, irregular-edged stone monuments dominated by a single frontally-scaled standing figure whose broad headdress fills the upper zone, with a round chest medallion and small rectangular blocky panels stacked vertically at the sides, a fairly specific shared scheme. The clearest difference is orientation and finish: B's figure is in crisp profile with clean incised detail and flanking sign-columns, while A's is frontal, heavily weathered and rendered in soft, rounded, almost sculptural volumes that lose most surface detail.
